steps.title: ground rlbench target
steps.code:
for c in gnd.output.get("candidates", []):
    print(c.get("label"), [round(x, 4) for x in c.get("pose", [])])

names_to_try = [
    "waypoint0",
    "waypoint1",
    "waypoint2",
    "waypoint3",
    "microwave",
    "microwave_door",
    "microwave_frame_vis",
    "microwave_door_joint",
]
for name in names_to_try:
    r = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name=name)
    if r.ok:
        p = r.output.get("pose_evidence", {})
        print(
            name,
            "->",
            p.get("source"),
            [round(x, 4) for x in (p.get("pose_world") or [])],
        )

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
w0 = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name="waypoint0")
w1 = primitives.call(name="ground_rlbench_target", target_name="waypoint1")
pose0 = w0.output["pose_evidence"]["pose_world"]
pose1 = w1.output["pose_evidence"]["pose_world"]
print("pose0:", pose0)
print("pose1:", pose1)

primitives.call(name="record_rlbench_evidence", key="waypoints", value=[pose0, pose1])

m0 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_name="waypoint0", target_pose=pose0)
print(
    "m0 ok:",
    m0.ok,
    "gripper_pose:",
    m0.output.get("observation", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_pose") if m0.ok else m0.error,
)

m1 = primitives.call(name="move_rlbench_arm_to", target_name="waypoint1", target_pose=pose1)
print(
    "m1 ok:",
    m1.ok,
    "gripper_pose:",
    m1.output.get("observation", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_pose") if m1.ok else m1.error,
)
